title: Synthesis of Mesoporous Samarium Oxide by Using CTAB
content: A mesoporous material is a type of porous material that has pores with diameters between 2 and 50 nanometers. This category follows the IUPAC definition that divides porous materials into three categories according to the size of their pores. Which are: micropores (less than 2 nm), mesopores (between 2 and 50 nm), and macropores (greater than 50 nm). On the other hand, in 1992, C. T. Kresge at al, proposed that the formation of a mesoporous materials take place using a liquid-crystal templating mechanism. Since then, many new mesoporous inorganic materials have been synthesized follow this proposal [1,2].
